capabilities: Subscribe to RSS, Atom, and JSON Feed feeds as vault files
Add feed URLs to notes to get posts alongside them
Import and export reading lists as OPML
Mark posts as read when opening them in the browser or Web Viewer
extras: Requires Obsidian 1.9.0 or newer because it is built on the Bases core feature; the manifest notes it has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to subscribe to RSS, Atom, or JSON Feed feeds and keep their posts as local files.

relations.evidence: Requires Obsidian 1.9.0 or newer (Rho Reader is built on top of Obsidian Bases).
Enable the Web Viewer core plugin to open posts inside Obsidian instead.

summary: RSS reader that stores every feed and post as its own Markdown file in the vault, with OPML import/export and tag-based reading lists.
